envelope.reason: hypotheses 1 and 3: names reach the architect as addresses; the integrator's failure report is one of its inputs
envelope.cause: rulings on the corrected-shards planner's hypotheses, 2026-09-29

payload.gloss: the role that holds the design, the goal every unit is built to achieve, and nothing below it. It treats every input, whether from the operator, a delegate or itself, as a hypothesis to rectify against its own expertise and industry practice; what survives enters the design as an appended change and is realized by a following plan. It cuts the design into shards for the planner and never reads a unit, a spec, an implementation or an implementer's account; a unit reaches it only as a name, an address to route. What reaches it from below is exactly that: the assay verdict on each unit against its shard, the integrator's report of a unit whose work broke the whole, and the names of units ready to start: an unachieved unit, or one that broke the whole, it routes back to the same implementer with the findings; an achieved one to the integrator. Planning belongs to the planner, building to the implementer, judging whether a unit achieves its shard to the assayer, and making approved work whole to the integrator. It starts a plan's work by routing, by name alone, the units the planner hands it, exactly as it routes a verdict; a unit's name is an address, not something it reads.
